agna agaCa rohitava agaCa Baradvajasyaja.h: अग्न आगछ रोहितव आगछ भरद्वाजस्याज सहसः सूनो वारावस्कन्दिन्न् उषसो जार
agna agaCa rohitava agaCa Baradvajasyaja.s: agna AgaCa rohitava AgaCa BaradvAjasyAja sahasaH sUno vArAvaskandinn uzaso jAra

agna iqa nama iqa nama fsiByo mantrakfdB.s: agna iqA nama iqA nama fziByo mantrakfdByo mantrapatiByo namo vo astu deveByaH

agna (ns. agna) indras ca dasuso duroRe.s: agna (MS. agnA) indraS ca dASuzo duroRe

agna udaDe ya ta isuryuva nama taya no m.s: agna udaDe yA ta izuryuvA nAma tayA no mfqa, tasyAs te namas, tasyAs ta upajIvanto BUyAsma

agna etan te brahmacariRan pari dadami.s: agna etaM te brahmacAriRaM pari dadAmi

agnayaH sagara sTa sagareRa namna rOdreR.s: agnayaH sagarA sTa sagareRa nAmnA rOdreRAnIkena pAta mAgnayaH pipfta mAgnayo gopAyata mA namo vo'stu mA mA hiMsizwa

agnayaH sagaraH sagara sTa sagareRa namn.h: अग्नयः सगराः सगरा स्थ सगरेण नाम्ना रौद्रेणानीकेन पात माग्नयः पिपृत माग्नयो गोपायत मा नमो वोऽस्तु मा मा हिंसिष्ट
agnayaH sagaraH sagara sTa sagareRa namn.s: agnayaH sagarAH sagarA sTa sagareRa nAmnA rOdreRAnIkena pAta mAgnayaH pipfta mAgnayo gopAyata mA namo vo'stu mA mA hiMsizwa

agnaye vEsvanaraya dvadasakapalo mfgaKar.s: agnaye vESvAnarAya dvAdaSakapAlo mfgAKare yadi nAgaCet

agnaye svaha somaya pavitravate varuRaya.s: agnaye svAhA somAya pavitravate varuRAya Danvantaraye manasA prAjApatyaM brahmaRe'gnaye svizwakfte
